content: Ibinọkpaabyi osi echekhi ọnang Abram
Ayongi mẹ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oyin Abram abẹ k'idachen, ọgbaakh-ẹ atzim, oben-ẹ bi,
Mada Abram ọbhaang idik nna, obhina bi, “O Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ẹfa biphyir, mbọng fa kọ asi anang-m, da kaam nni nnwa mmoni, ọnọng kw'óchi-m obo ode Eliyeza kw'ofon Damaskọs.”
Abram oben bi, “Kọ kaam va atzima ananga; mẹ wọ, obira k'ẹhọhmmọr chaam wọ óchi-m obo.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọgbaak Abram atzim, oben-ẹ bi, “Mma e, kwẹ mando kode. Obira nwa araang ọ́chọ-ọ obo, nnwa kw'ofon k'adima pọ, wọ ọ́chọ-ọ obo e.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, Ibinọkpaabyi otzim-ẹ oyin k'iyaan, ọkhọhkh-ẹ ndodori sa nwobh k'ọrọngkpakpa, oben-ẹ bi, “Akk'ara odem kwa ndodori nhaabhi, idikha afha abhik sẹ, mando kwa va pa va pọ ikhina bẹ áhaabh.”
Abram okhera idik nna s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọgbaakh-ẹ, k'odik-ọkka. Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọtzọkh-ẹ mach'ọnọng kw'otzor-otzor k'itzitzikha sẹ.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obiro oben Abram bi, “Kaam nde Ọvaarnọng kwọ, kaam wọ iwa ndọkh-ọ k'obhon kw'Ur k'ẹkhọma ch'anọng pa Kaldi, ndim-ọ nkwu nnang irerek nna, ifha atzọkha sẹ mach'ekkema chọ.”
Abram obhin-ẹ bi, “O Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ẹfa biphyir, yan kwa kaam ńdima ńnonga bi, kaam ndọkha irek nna mach'ekkema chaam o?”
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obhin-ẹ bi, “Kọ rọhng, atza aror ọbhaamnwa-kwakwẹ, ọmaana ovu-gbokha, ttara erukhimaan-dim, p'ade cho attaan-attaan, ọmaana igbegbaa ttara ikpomikha, atzima akwu.”
Abram ọtzọkha nden nnuma biphyir otzima okwu, ọbhaakha kpenamkpen k'obe ọfa, ohok igbokha kpenamkpen ikkeri oyok. Yina, ọnọhn fẹ-fẹ f'oni agbokha afa ọbhaak.
Mada opyiri k'ogbe kw'attẹrẹ ahak bi akwu achi abukhi p'ekpo mbya, Abram okhubh bẹ.
Mada opyiri k'ẹchọhkha k'ogbe kw'ewu ẹn-ẹhak, ọda osi Abram, ọttaabha maa ọmọm, ipyerungi bi kaang ibubha Abram maa ojora f'ideden ọsẹ-ẹ.

Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Abram bi, “Ronga k'odik-ọkka bi, va pa va pọ áde akhekhen-nọng k'obhon kw'oni kwabẹ ode. Bẹ áruk mẹ mach'abira, anọng ahok bẹ k'ebira, bẹ ábira anang bẹ ihem, ọttọhk ka cho ẹnọhna.
Yina, kaam ńnang ẹkhọma nda ch'ekhe bẹ k'ebira ettuma. Ogbe kw'ebira ọkk'ọkwọbha, bẹ atzima ojibhada kw'ideden anaanga ebira ch'obhon nwuma.
Onode kọ, ma for sọ, áruk akpen matzẹmaa atzam, yina aning ape bẹ anọhng-ọ atzor abatte k'odidiri.
Ottong igbọ inna sa va pa va pọ, bẹ ákhuna m'irerek nna, okhuri bi, ogbe otzim opyiri, kwa kaam ńgwubh anọng p'Amọr m'ibe nna, okhuri itzama sabẹ.”

Mada okwu opyiri ogbe kw'ewuchen ekk'edimi, erungi epyi bi kaang. Abram ore irọhkha s'irorong s'ekpon ewobh k'ẹtzaanga, ttara ikhebh sa iwọm ekpon, ch'ereng k'ottem kwa nden nna sa bẹ ajọhkhi k'abiri-biri, ẹkwọbha efona.
Mẹ ewu nda, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi echekhi oben Abram bi, “Va pa va pọ bọ, pa kaam ńdọkha irerek nna ttẹwọr k'ọraanga kw'Ijip, maa apyiri k'ọraanga kwa Yupharetes ńnang, bẹ akhaama.
Anọng p'arukhi m'irerek nna ade: abaKen, ọmaana abaKeniz, ọmaana abaKadamọn,
ọmaana abaHet, ọmaana abaPẹriz, ọmaana abaRephayim,
ọmaana abAmọr, ọmaana abaKenaan, ọmaana abaGirgash, ttara abaJẹbus.”
